mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating price pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling does not produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a post-recession recovery phase (GDP growth above 1.5% annualized and housing starts above 1.5 million units), a sustained increase in residential construction activity (HOUST) signals expanding consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods meeting regime condition, S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for signal is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, signaling economic weakness that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1.5 million units (1500 in thousands) reflects strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1500, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) and decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates the Federal Reserve is responding to inflation with rate cuts, which typically leads to positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of CPIAUCSL rising and FEDFUNDS falling does not produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of high unemployment (UNRATE > 6.0%), a monthly increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 signals a labor market recovery that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods meeting regime condition (UNRATE > 6.0%), S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 200, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
